actor.name: Claire O'Shea
actor.notes: Signed open letter, 2025-02-27: 2% on wealth above £10m, £24bn a year (in a letter on UK aid cuts). Signed as a leader of the organisation named; whether the organisation itself endorses the wealth tax is not recorded

evidence.design_detail: 2% on wealth above £10m, £24bn a year (in a letter on UK aid cuts)
evidence.quote_original: A wealth tax of just 2% on wealth above £10 million (affecting just 0.04% of the population) would raise £24bn annually.
evidence.source_title: Open letter to the Prime Minister from UK INGO leaders on UK aid cuts, 27 Feb 2025
evidence.grading_note: Signed a letter whose text states a 2% wealth tax above £10m as the alternative to aid cuts: grade A (formal act with specifics). Signed as leader of the organisation named; the letter is mainly about aid, with the wealth tax as one paragraph.
